note: passkey-vault test vectors v1. Bytes are hex; keys and DER are base64url without padding. Test-only keys: never use them.
rule: PRF input = SHA-256('passkey-vault/prf-salt/v1'); wrap key = HKDF-SHA256(ikm=PRF output, salt='passkey-vault/hkdf-salt/v1', info='passkey-vault/wrap-key/v1', L=32); wrap = AES-256-GCM(wrap key, iv, master key, AAD=lp('passkey-vault/wrap/v1')||lp(credential_id)); item = AES-256-GCM(master key, iv, UTF-8 secret, AAD=lp('passkey-vault/item/v1')||lp(name)||lp(site)||lp(account)). Ciphertext hex includes the 16-byte tag
